name: TRACE IT
summary: 纸上铁路逻辑解谜，2026 年 10 月 25 日上架，HuntForge 开发、LIGHT IT 发行，分类为休闲／独立：每行每列旁标注需要放置轨道的格数，从边缘入口把直轨与弯轨连成一条不分叉不成环的线路接到出口，并称每关都经计算机校验只有唯一解。商店 AI 披露按领域列了三项：配乐用 Suno 制作、部分视觉素材借助 AI 图像生成工具、代码用 AI 助手构思与调试，并单独声明所有 AI 协助内容均为预生成、游玩过程中不实时生成 AI 内容，全部内容在入库前经开发者审阅、测试与打磨。本站据此把音乐、美术与代码登记为已使用、游戏运行登记为明确声明未使用，其余四个领域因披露没有点名而登记为未说明。披露正文以“The developers of LIGHT IT”自称，而商店记录的开发者为 HuntForge、LIGHT IT 为发行方，本站保留这一称谓差异。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。

english.summary: A paper railway logic puzzle released on Oct 25, 2026, developed by HuntForge, published by LIGHT IT and filed under Casual and Indie, where each row and column carries the number of cells that must hold track and you join straight and curved pieces from the edge entrance to the exit without branches or loops, with every level stated to be computer verified as having exactly one answer. The Steam AI disclosure lists in-game music produced with Suno, some visual assets made with AI image generation tools and code where AI assistants helped brainstorm implementation ideas and debug, and it states separately that all AI assisted content is pre-generated and nothing is generated live during gameplay. This site records music, art and code as used and live generation as explicitly ruled out, keeps the word some as a scope limit, notes that the store blurb sells a hand drawn paper look while the disclosure mentions AI image tools, and leaves writing, voice, translation and marketing not addressed. The disclosure text calls itself the developers of LIGHT IT while the store identity lists HuntForge as developer and LIGHT IT as publisher, and this difference is reported rather than resolved, with every finding resting on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, including the publisher style self reference and the sentence ruling out live generation, plus the identity of HuntForge as developer and LIGHT IT as publisher on a full release dated Oct 25, 2026. The English discussion board shows 1 visible topic out of 1 in total, a quality of life suggestion with no AI discussion. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json with 6 results, and two sources were registered and read in full, the GameDB.ai and HowMuchAI entry pages for this game, whose transcriptions match the store text while their own AI grades and confidence values are automatic third party judgements this site does not adopt. Of the remaining results one was the store page of a different, similarly named title, one a localised copy of this store page already covered by the official evidence and two were an unrelated company profile page and a conference proceedings PDF. The disclosure calls its authors the developers of LIGHT IT while the store lists HuntForge as developer, and this site reports the difference without changing the judgement, keeping every finding on the developer own statement without independent audit.
